asset.name: ConversationShell
asset.description: The complete conversational workspace coordinating transcript, composer, context, artifacts, agent activity, approvals, responsive panels, and scroll restoration as one surface.

requires.reason: The transcript is the shared message collection.
Current agent activity is always visible.
Artifacts and activity present as a desktop side panel and a mobile drawer without losing state.
Loading, empty, partial, stale, error, and offline presentation are delegated rather than reimplemented.

regions.purpose: The conversation history with streaming, branching, and history loading.
Message entry with attachments, commands, and generation controls.
What the agent can currently see, with inspection and removal.
Artifacts, plans, activity, and approvals beside the conversation.

signatureMoment.description: Work the agent produces appears beside the conversation rather than scrolling away inside it, so the transcript stays a record and the artifacts stay reachable.

rationale: The flagship surface of the domain and the one with no adequate prior art to copy. Its defining decision is separating transcript from workbench: conversation is a record that scrolls, artifacts and plans are objects that persist, and collapsing the two is why most agent interfaces become unusable past a few dozen turns.
